item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02590","case1_error":"Correct cost and splitting formulas are followed by unsupported incorrect answer numbers; each person owes $25.","case2_error":"The leading answer marker says $5, but the derivation and conclusion correctly give $4.","reason":"Case 2 has only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02591","case1_error":"Reports the seven brownies given to Carl and Simon as brownies remaining, instead of subtracting them from ten.","case2_error":"Reports the friend's 40% contribution as John's payment instead of John's remaining 60%.","reason":"Both answer with the allocated portion instead of the requested remainder.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02592","case1_error":"Provides unsupported final answer 19 after outlining the correct counting approach; the total is 17.","case2_error":"Treats the goats-to-sheep ratio as goats-to-total, miscomputes sheep, and omits the fractions of animals sold.","reason":"Case 1 supplies an unsupported number without showing faulty calculations; case 2 explicitly constructs incorrect mathematical relations.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02593","case1_error":"Evaluates the correctly written calorie sum as 2175 instead of 1975.","case2_error":"Evaluates the correctly written addition 132 + 35 as 144 instead of 167.","reason":"Both numerically miscalculate a correctly written addition expression.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02594","case1_error":"Incorrectly equates 120/2 with 60/2, introducing an extra division, then concludes 15 without support.","case2_error":"Gives unsupported final answer 100 after correctly writing 20 + (2 × 30), which equals 80.","reason":"Case 1 visibly introduces an extra division in an erroneous equality; case 2 shows no faulty calculation, only an unsupported final number.","judgment":"different"}]}
